description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 31.07.2017 to 06.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs payments, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
